build_SORTTracker: build a SORT tracker with Kalman filter motion model and configurable object score threshold
init_track_SORTTracker: initialize a new track with a given id and bounding box using Kalman filter initiation
update_track_SORTTracker: update an existing track with new detection data and Kalman filter state estimation
track_SORTTracker: run the SORT tracking forward pass to associate detections with existing tracks using motion and ReID
pop_invalid_tracks_SORTTracker: remove invalid tracks that have disappeared for too long or remain tentative without matches
